BOOK ONE · LESSON 079

Carol's shopping list

卡罗尔的购物单

A dialogue lesson in which Carol is making a shopping list while Tom asks what they need: tea, coffee, sugar, jam, tomatoes, and meat, but no beer or wine ('And I'm not going to get any!'), ending with the joke that neither of them has much money. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and sorting shop items into the correct shop columns (butcher's, greengrocer's, grocer's, newsagent's, chemist's, baker's). Grammar exercises cover fill-in with much/many/some/any/a lot of, and answering have-got questions according to the examples.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. What is Carol not going to buy? 听录音，然后回答问题。卡罗尔不准备买什么？

Listen to the recording, then answer: What is Carol not going to buy?

  1. 1

    TOM

    What are you doing, Carol?

    汤姆：卡罗尔，你在干什么？

  2. 2

    CAROL

    I'm making a shopping list, Tom.

    卡罗尔：我在写购物单，汤姆。

  3. 3

    TOM

    What do we need?

    汤姆：我们都需要什么？

  4. 4

    CAROL

    We need a lot of things this week.

    卡罗尔：这星期我们需要很多东西。

  5. 5

    CAROL

    I must go to the grocer's.
    We haven't got much tea or coffee,
    and we haven't got any sugar or jam.

    卡罗尔：我得去一下食品店。我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。

  6. 6

    TOM

    What about vegetables?

    汤姆：蔬菜呢？

  7. 7

    CAROL

    I must go to the greengrocer's.
    We haven't got many tomatoes,
    but we've got a lot of potatoes.

    卡罗尔：我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。我们的番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。

  8. 8

    CAROL

    I must go to the butcher's, too.
    We need some meat.
    We haven't got any meat at all.

    卡罗尔：我还要到肉店去一下。我们需要些肉。我们一点肉也没有了。

  9. 9

    TOM

    Have we got any beer and wine?

    汤姆：我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

  10. 10

    CAROL

    No, we haven't.
    And I'm not going to get any!

    卡罗尔：没有了。不过，我不打算去买！

  11. 11

    TOM

    I hope that you've got some money.

    汤姆：我希望你还有钱。

  12. 12

    CAROL

    I haven't got much.

    卡罗尔：我的钱不多了。

  13. 13

    TOM

    Well, I haven't got much either!

    汤姆：唉，我也不多了！

Notes on the text 课文注释

make a shopping list

写一张采购物品的单子。

a lot of

当"许多"讲，既可用在可数名词前，又能用在不可数名词前，一般用于肯定句。

We haven't got any meat at all.

我们一点肉也没有了。at all 这个词组用在否定句中，表示"丝毫"、"一点"、"根本"的意思，有强调作用。have got 与 have（"有"）同义。

many 和 much

均可译成"许多"，但用法不同：many 主要用于疑问句和否定句中，放在可数名词之前，如 many tomatoes；much 用于疑问句和否定句中，放在不可数名词之前，如 much tea, much money。

参考译文
汤姆：卡罗尔，你在干什么？
卡罗尔：我在写购物单，汤姆。
汤姆：我们都需要什么？
卡罗尔：这星期我们需要很多东西。
卡罗尔：我得去一下食品店。我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。
汤姆：蔬菜呢？
卡罗尔：我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。我们的番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。
卡罗尔：我还要到肉店去一下。我们需要些肉。我们一点肉也没有了。
汤姆：我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？
卡罗尔：没有了。不过，我不打算去买！
汤姆：我希望你还有钱。
卡罗尔：我的钱不多了。
汤姆：唉，我也不多了！

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

I. Fill in the blanks with "much", "many", "some", "any" or "a lot of". 用 much, many, some, any 或 a lot of 填空。

Fill in the blanks with "much", "many", "some", "any" or "a lot of". 用 much, many, some, any 或 a lot of 填空。

Fill each blank with the correct word: much, many, some, any, or a lot of.

Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 509). Some blanks accept two forms (e.g. some/a lot of).

II. Answer the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句回答下列问题。

Answer the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句回答下列问题。

1. a. Have you got a pencil and a ruler? → I've got a pencil, but I haven't got a ruler.
2. a. Have you got any boxes and baskets? → I've got some boxes, but I haven't got any baskets.
3. a. Have you got any milk and water? → I've got some milk, but I haven't got any water.
4. a. Have you got many eggs and chickens? → I've got a lot of eggs, but I haven't got many chickens.
5. a. Have you got much paper and money? → I've got a lot of paper, but I haven't got much money.

Answer each question following the example pattern for its group (some/any, a lot of/many, a lot of/much).

The lettered sub-questions a of each group are printed examples (not editable). The b-f answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 509-510).
